title: Shelf entry acceptance pilot — copy and ops checklist
content:
Purpose:
Short guide + acceptance checklist for piloting a partner tile onto the cloud marketplace shelf. Focus is on a narrow pilot (5 partners): fast verification of copy variants, telemetry and trial provisioning, plus ops runbook for go/no-go.

Goal:
- Get a reproducible 45–60 minute review/runbook that partner PMs and internal listing owners can use to validate readiness.
- Capture copy variants that map to marketplace UX constraints (short tile title, 1-line subtitle, 300-char blurb, feature bullets).
- Define gating criteria across security, billing, telemetry, legal, telemetry and SRE smoke tests.

Audience:
- Primary: partner product managers, partner ops, go-to-market engineers
- Secondary: legal/compliance reviewers, SRE on-call for marketplace launch

Quick acceptance checklist (must pass all items):
1) Copy & creative
   - Short tile title (<= 50 chars) and subtitle (<= 120 chars) ready in English.
   - 300-char blurb edited for clarity and benefit-first language.
   - At least 2 tile imagery options: 1 static PNG (1200x627) + 1 small svg icon.
   - 3 CTA variants prepared (Start free trial, Request demo, Get API key).
2) Functional integration
   - Trial provisioning flow hits sandbox API and returns provisioning token within 10s.
   - API key scoping validated (read-only vs trial-eval access).
   - Billing SKU mapped and test purchase flow exercised in sandbox.
3) Telemetry & observability
   - Marketplace telemetry event schema confirmed (tile_impression, trial_start, upgrade_click).
   - Sample telemetry record in staging pipeline with expected fields (tile_id, partner_id, region, timestamp, outcome).
   - Trace link established to Redwood Console for per-route SLO inspection.
4) Security & legal gating
   - Minimal data residency requirement documented; if partner stores customer data, mapping to Private offering is noted.
   - Privacy Q&A filled and signed by partner legal.
   - Required CISO checklist items: SOC2 status, KMS integration plan (if applicable).
5) QA smoke tests
   - Tile preview renders in listing with correct title/CTA.
   - Clicking CTA either launches trial flow or opens contact form in < 3 clicks.
   - Trial provisioning end-to-end validated twice, inc. token expiry handling.
   - Broken-link and accessibility quick check (alt tags, contrast) passed.
6) Localization & accessibility
   - English approved; plan and owner documented for i18n of top 3 markets (en, de, fr).
   - WCAG basic checks performed on tile landing page.

Market copy primitives (pick one set per partner; A/B available for pilot):
- Tile title (short): "Redwood Inference — Low-latency LLM API"
- Subtitle (one line): "Predictable latency and cost controls for production LLMs"
- 300-char blurb (benefit-first): "Redwood Inference provides a developer-first inference platform with hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Ship LLM features with predictable latency, transparent cost controls, and enterprise-ready security — powered by GPU-optimized serving and smart routing."
- 3 feature bullets (<= 80 chars each):
   * "Fast streaming responses, low token cost"
   * "Dedicated GPU pools and SLA-backed latency"
   * "Private deployments and KMS integrations"
- CTA options: ["Start free trial", "Request dedicated demo", "Contact enterprise sales"]

Sample short FAQs to include on tile detail:
- Q: How does trial capacity work?
  A: Trial grants limited tokens on hosted API for 14 days; Dedicated trials require sales coordination.
- Q: Is data retained?
  A: Hosted API retains telemetry per policy; Private deployments enable customer-managed retention.

Ops runbook (45–60 minute checklist for review session):
- 0–10m: Verify tile copy + imagery inside marketplace preview. Capture screenshots.
- 10–25m: Run provisioning flow and verify token issuance + sample inference. Document latencies.
- 25–40m: Walk through telemetry pipeline and confirm events in staging console.
- 40–50m: Smoke test billing flow (test SKU) and confirm charging simulation.
- 50–60m: Final sign-off: legal tick, SRE acceptance, partner PM confirmation.

Launch gating rubric (pass/fail notes):
- Must pass all security/legal gating items or show documented mitigation with timeline (failed = hold).
- If trial provisioning exceeds 10s median latency under test load, mark as "needs perf work" (failed).
- If telemetry missing >10% of expected keys during staging run, escalate to infra.

Localization & messaging notes:
- Avoid vendor-specific jargon in 300-char blurb; use outcome-driven phrases ("reduce latency", "lower token cost").
- Provide 1 locale owner per target market; partner should supply translated strings or commit to timeline.

Accessibility quick checklist:
- Alt text for tile image present.
- Button contrast passes AA.
- Keyboard focus order sensible on tile landing modal.

Open questions for pilot cohort:
- Do we standardize on a single CTA per tile or allow 2 CTAs (trial + contact)? Pros/cons to decide with PMs.
- Which telemetry fields can be optional to partners vs required for Redwood analytics ingestion?
- SLA language for Dedicated listing — do we surface target latencies on tile or keep in documentation only?

Next steps (owner assignments):
- Maya Green: finalize copy A/B and submit PR to assets repo (due 2025-12-01).
- Diego Alvarez: validate trial provisioning endpoints and record staging telemetry sample (due 2025-12-08).
- Priya Nair: legal privacy Q&A completion and stub contract clause for marketplace trial terms (due 2025-12-10).
- Jordan Lee: run accessibility smoke test and produce checklist artifact (due 2025-12-05).

Appendix — suggested PR title and notes for assets repo:
- PR title: "marketplace: add Redwood Inference tile + trial flow hooks (pilot cohort)"
- Notes: include tile metadata JSON, images (1200x627 PNG + icon), short and long copy files, telemetry schema doc link, acceptance-test script.

This doc is intentionally concise and operational — use it as the working runbook during pilot week. Record outcomes in the linked Confluence page and update acceptance items to move status to final on success.
